pages.title: Books and Shelves
pages.text: Storage Books trade how many item types they hold against stack depth. Use any Storage Book on a vanilla bookshelf to make the conversion-only Storage Bookshelf; it has no standalone recipe.

pages.title: Power and Connection
pages.text: Everything with an item form stays in the Aura creative tab. Connect shelves to a Bookshelf Coordinator with clear lines of sight, then place a powered Aura network block beside it. Right-click empty-handed to open the browser. Draw rises with shelf count: 5 power for one shelf, 31 for five, 81 for ten.

pages.title: Search and Retrieve
pages.text: Search localized item names, scroll the 9-by-3 results, select a stack, set an amount or choose Max, then press Retrieve. The browser groups matching items with identical data components.

pages.title: Deposit and Withdraw
pages.text: Use the Coordinator while holding an item to deposit. Sneak-use it empty-handed to withdraw the first stack. Full counts can exceed 64; incomplete, unloaded, unreachable, or unpowered networks disable actions. Stored items remain in their books.

pages.title: Book Limits I
pages.text: Basic 27x64; Dense 8x1,000; Very Dense 4x5,000; Super Dense 2x25,000; Extremely Dense 1x100,000. Light: 100x32; Very Light 150x16; Super Light 1,000x4; Extremely Light 10,000x1. Each pair is item types x items per type.

pages.title: Book Limits II
pages.text: Mineral: 8 x 100,000; Mob and Farming: 32 x 100,000 each; Mod: 64 x 100. Values are item types x items each. Mineral accepts common mineral tags, Mob accepts listed drops and spawn eggs, Farming accepts crop and seed tags, and Mod accepts non-Minecraft items from one namespace.
